Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

announcer noun

on radio or television

also newsreader, presenter, anchor (news), anchorman, anchorwoman, presenter (news)

late Latin

Vulg. Act. 17.18 (Lewis & Short): one who proclaims
Traupman 163
Traupman 271

annūntiātor, annūntiātōris m.

noun, third declension

an announcer

Church Latin uses it of one who proclaims; the broadcasting sense is modern.

Other words

  • annūntiātrīx, annūntiātrīcis f.

    noun, third declension · also used · modern · Traupman 163

  • nūntiātor, nūntiātōris m. — an announcer, a newsreader, an anchor

    noun, third declension · also used · modern · Traupman 271

    Lewis & Short has nūntiātor only in Christian writers (Arnobius, Tertullian), “a reporter, an announcer”; the radio and television sense is modern.

See also broadcast.
